title: Singular Efficiency of Separable Indirect Effects with Vanishing Exact-Event Audit Fractions
banked_reason: Math and decision reviews pass; D0.5.G grades subfield below the field floor because paper_score_ceiling 7 < 7.4, with no bounded same-contract repair. Independent validity consult confirms bank downgraded.
gap_reasons: That attainment uses exhaustive enumeration of an enormous hazard grid, and the delivered package contains no implemented certified evaluator or finite-sample coverage evidence supporting its prospective planning use.
The projected score is constrained by this implementation gap and the specialized randomized, covariate-free inspection design
proof_attempt_summary: The supervisor-authorized proposal retry succeeded; discovery derived the coupled singular efficiency profile, cancellation transition, certified evaluator, and sharp efficient-Gaussian audit range with an observable attainer and same-class obstruction. Five source records were independently verified and attested, with adapted classical probability/comparator steps separated as proved discovery bridges; math and decision panels passed, but the package score capped the achieved tier at subfield. No Lean formalization was launched; a practical estimator implementation, finite-sample study, or broader inference contract remains a new research program rather than a bounded repair.
tldr: The proved coupled score operator evaluates the singular efficiency price of exact-event audits for a causal separable indirect incidence from terminal cause-labeled snapshots. Its explicit profile is \(W(P)+\kappa(P)b(P)^2/\sqrt q\), uniformly through nonzero-effect cancellation, with transition coordinate \(b(P)/q^{1/4}\). A total observable snapshot-augmented estimator, certified variance evaluator and honest studentized intervals attain the canonical variance uniformly exactly on public audit floors satisfying \(n^{2/3}a_n\to\infty\); a same-class oracle obstruction proves this boundary sharp for the efficient-Gaussian contract, without ruling out inefficient or nonnormal inference below it.
gap: Exact-event separable influence functions and fixed-fraction event/current-status fusion are established. Their combination does not evaluate a uniformly valid local coefficient and regular contribution when audit information degenerates and the horizon source vanishes.
fill: The core binds the original score operator, the explicit cancellation variance, and the two open construction targets: an evaluated uniform singular profile and its primitive-based observable attainment. The consumer is prospective precision planning and confidence calibration for the prostate-cancer mechanism question illustrated by Syriopoulou and coauthors.
